purpose: Check whether the unchanged main build crosses the planned control limits in this environment.
method: Use the vector-compaction-protocol.json v1 timing method with the Node controller. Point both BASE_DIR and CANDIDATE_DIR to main. Run all 14 cases once, with exactly three process pairs in each runtime. Keep every observation.
noiseRule: Flag a case if its geometric mean candidate/baseline time is outside [0.95, 1.05], or all three paired ratios are on one side of [0.97, 1.03]. A flag means this short method cannot settle a change of that size for this case.
followup: Inspect warm-up and batch durations if noise is flagged. Do not change production code or weaken acceptance limits in response to the A/A labels. Preserve v1 and write a new method before new timing if its measurement scope must change.
